MR-I READYBRAIN

Set the head up in the head coil, run the 3-plane localiser, plan the sagittal T1 on the falx — then angle the axial to the AC-PC line and the coronal perpendicular to it
Demonstration only — an educational simulation of MRI planning, not a medical device, not for clinical use. Every diagnostic image comes from one real 3 T MRI of a healthy volunteer's brain (public-domain research data), shown with its true geometry; the localiser is rebuilt from the same scan — see the credits on the results screen.
